meta.name: Player Protection Decision Matrix
meta.description: This is the same rules as PLAYBOOK.md, written so a scoring engine can read them directly instead of a person reading the document each time.

minor.description: 3 or more separate player reports, or an automatic unusual activity flag below 70% confidence

moderate.description: An automatic unusual activity flag at 70% confidence or more, or a checked clip or log, or 5 or more reports that support each other

severe.description: An automatic unusual activity flag at 90% confidence or more, plus extra proof such as logs, clips, or several separate reports

below_minimum.description: Flags that do not meet the level's proof requirement are saved for tracking trends but do not trigger a punishment. They go to a person for review instead.

severe.offense_1: 30 day ban (or permanent, depending on the case)
severe.offense_3_plus: permanent ban plus account flagged for evasion monitoring

cheating.label: Cheating / Hacking
cheating.definition: Using outside software or scripts to gain an unfair advantage

triggers.minor: A cosmetic or utility tool with no gameplay effect, for example a harmless FPS unlocker or overlay
triggers.moderate: Confirmed macro or script use, single session
triggers.severe: Confirmed script use across multiple sessions, or unusually high win rates that match automated play

exploitation.label: Exploitation
exploitation.definition: Using game bugs or features that were not meant to work this way, for an advantage

triggers.minor: Minor visual or cosmetic glitch abuse with no real impact on competition
triggers.moderate: Confirmed use of a game exploit for a real competitive or progress advantage
triggers.severe: The same exploit used again and again across many matches

matchmaking_abuse.label: Matchmaking Abuse
matchmaking_abuse.definition: Tricking the matchmaking or ranking system

triggers.minor: An unclear sign of a possible smurf account, a new account doing much better than expected for its age
triggers.moderate: Confirmed proof of paid boosting or rank manipulation done on purpose
triggers.severe: A group of people working together to boost accounts or manipulate ranks

toxicity.label: Toxicity & Abusive Behavior
toxicity.definition: Harassment, hate speech, threats, or targeted abuse through chat, voice, or gestures

triggers.minor: One incident that is not targeted at a specific person, for example one heated insult in a match
triggers.moderate: Repeated or targeted insults or slurs within one match or over a short time
triggers.severe: Threats of violence, sharing someone's private info, or a group of people harassing someone together

ban_evasion.label: Ban Evasion & Account Abuse
ban_evasion.definition: Making a new account to get around an active ban, or sharing and selling accounts tied to boosting or getting around a ban

triggers.severe: Any confirmed alternate account bypassing an active ban. Evasion is always severe, no lower level applies.

ban_evasion.special_rule: When evasion is confirmed, the punishment steps restart at the ORIGINAL account's offense count, not the new account's. Evasion itself is also logged as its own separate severe offense.

steps: submission: player sends an appeal with more information within 14 days
review: a different reviewer looks again at the original proof against this matrix, without seeing what punishment was already given
outcome: punishment stays the same, is reduced, or is reversed, with the reason written down against the specific rules that were or were not met
appeals.note: Repeated overturns on the same kind of detection are a sign of a detection or process problem, not just one mistake. Track this as a pattern, not case by case.
